raw:
“I remember a birthday picnic my friends organized for me. There were paper lanterns above the picnic table and a lemon cake with candles. Those are the details that stand out when I think about it—the lanterns overhead and the cake there in front of me, with my friends around.

What made me happy was that they’d put it together for me. I remember thinking how nice it was to have people who wanted to celebrate with me. It wasn’t just having a birthday cake; it was feeling remembered and cared about. I felt really glad to be there with them.”
